designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a rigorous, professional, and uncompromisingly utilitarian aesthetic tailored for data-dense productivity tools. It deliberately rejects platform-native chrome in favor of a unified, application-specific identity characterized by a deep navy command band, a pristine white workspace sheet, and precise functional accents. The emotional response is one of absolute control, computational reliability, and high-performance clarity.

The visual style is strictly **Corporate / Modern** combined with a flattened, highly functional workspace paradigm. It prioritizes information density, legibility, and uncompromising alignment over decorative flair.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system uses a strict, data-dense **fixed grid and layout model** designed to maximize visible workspace. Spacing increments follow a tight 4px baseline rhythm, preventing wasted canvas area and ensuring components pack tightly without colliding.

Layouts are structured around fixed-width side panels (inspector), static toolbar heights, and fluid central data grids. Breakpoints are optimized for desktop and tablet viewports where complex data manipulation occurs, prioritizing absolute coordinate predictability over fluid reflowing.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is treated with extreme minimalism. The interface is predominantly flat, relying on crisp hairlines (`#e0e5ee`) and structural background shifts (`#f3f5f9` vs `#ffffff`) to define container boundaries rather than heavy drop shadows. 

Gradients, blurs, and glassmorphism are strictly prohibited. The singular exception is floating contextual menus, dropdowns, and modal dialogs, which utilize a single, soft, non-distracting elevation shadow (`0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)`) to lift them cleanly above the workspace sheet.

## Components

All components are custom-rendered to guarantee a uniform cross-platform experience across Linux, macOS, Windows, web, and tablet environments, bypassing native platform chrome entirely.

- **Toolbar:** Features icon-above-label buttons (64px wide) organized within the deep navy command band, separated by thin vertical hairlines. Hover states apply a lighter navy fill (`#22325a`), while active tools lock into the bright blue accent tint (`#2f6fed`).
- **Formula Bar:** Comprises a cell reference indicator, a distinct "fx" label, a monospace input field, and dedicated cancel/accept execution buttons.
- **Data Grid:** The core workspace component featuring a 48px row-number gutter, explicit header rows with type badges (`#`, `$`, `Aa`, calendar) and micro-histograms, 28px body rows delineated by hairlines, 2px accent selection rings, and tinted active columns. Formula results display in distinct purple ink.
- **Inspector:** A fixed 300px right-hand panel utilizing top-level navigation tabs, uppercase section titles, flat dropdowns, segmented controls, steppers, and switches.
- **Sheet Tabs:** Positioned at the bottom-left of the workspace in a classic spreadsheet arrangement—flat tabs featuring an active state on the surface color anchored by a 2px accent top edge, accompanied by a clean sheet creation button.
- **Status Bar:** A compact 26px footer displaying monospace figures for total rows, aggregated selection data (sum, average, count), hardware acceleration status, and computation execution time.
- **KPI Cards:** Compact metric displays housing a label, large monospace numerical figure, embedded sparkline, and a directional delta chip utilizing positive or negative semantic colors.
- **Charts:** Completely flat, minimal data visualizations featuring thin gridlines, zero 3D perspective, and strict adherence to the standardized color-blind safe series palette.

# omxplorer · Blueprint (light with a branded navy band)

One fixed look on every platform with a strong identity, the way Office apps carry a coloured title band: a deep navy title bar and toolbar with white icons over a bright white sheet, and a clear blue accent.

## Colour (exact values)
- Title bar and toolbar band: #14213d, icons and labels on it #e8edf7, hover on it #22325a, active tool on it #2f6fed
- Page behind the sheet: #f3f5f9 · Sheet, tables, cards, inspector: #ffffff
- Raised (header row, gutter): #f1f4f9 · Selection fill: #e5eefe · Hairline: #e0e5ee · Strong line: #c5cede
- Ink (text, numbers): #111827 · Body: #374151 · Secondary: #6b7280
- Accent (selection ring, primary button, active tab, focus): #2f6fed, text on accent #ffffff
- Formula values: #7b3fe4 · Good: #138a52 · Bad: #d23f57 · Warning: #b7791f
- Chart series in order (colour-blind safe): #2f6fed, #f08c2e, #13a39a, #d9485f, #7b61ff, #8aa23b, #6b7785, #c2569f

## Type (bundled with the app, so every platform looks identical)
- UI: Inter. 13px body, 12px captions, 11px toolbar labels, 15px section titles (600), 20px page titles (700).
- Numbers and code: JetBrains Mono, tabular, right-aligned in columns. Cell values, formulas, KPI figures and the status bar use it.

## Shape and depth
- Flat. No gradients, glass or blur. Only floating menus and dialogs get one soft shadow (0 4px 16px at 12%).
- Radius: 6px panels, cards and buttons; 4px inputs and chips; 0 for table cells.
- Icons: Lucide line icons, 1.5px stroke, 18px. Never emoji.

## Components (same on Linux, Mac, Windows, web and iPad; never the platform native look)
- Toolbar: icon-above-label buttons 64px wide, in groups separated by thin vertical hairlines; hover fills the raised colour; an active tool has the accent tint.
- Formula bar: cell reference box, "fx" label, monospace input, cancel and accept buttons.
- Data grid: row-number gutter 48px, header row with the column name, a small type badge (#, $, Aa, calendar) and a tiny distribution histogram under the name; body rows 28px with hairlines; selected cell 2px accent ring; selected column tinted; formula columns show their values in the formula colour.
- Inspector: right panel 300px, tabs across the top, small uppercase section titles, flat dropdowns, segmented controls, steppers, switches.
- Sheet tabs: bottom-left, like Excel: flat tabs, active tab on the surface colour with a 2px accent top edge, then a + button.
- Status bar: 26px, monospace figures: rows, selection sum / average / count, the GPU name and the last computation time.
- KPI card: label, big monospace figure, sparkline, delta chip (good or bad colour).
- Charts: flat, thin gridlines, no 3D, the chart series in order.

## Motion
- Short fades only (120 ms). No springs, zooms or blur.

screens.prompt:
Design a complete, high-precision desktop spreadsheet screen (1440x900) for data scientists called 'omxplorer', adhering exactly to DESIGN.md (#14213d branded navy title bar, #f3f5f9 sheet background, JetBrains Mono numbers, flat elevation, Lucide icons).

Detailed Layout and Elements:
1. Title Bar (#14213d background, #e8edf7 text/icons):
   - Left: Lowercase app name "omxplorer" in bold sans-serif with subtle branding dot.
   - Center: Document title "orders.csv — 1,000,000 rows" with a small tabular badge.
   - Right: "Share" secondary button (#22325a hover, border border-hairline/20) and "Save" accent button (#2f6fed background, white text). Window controls or user avatar.

2. Branded Toolbar (#14213d band, icon-above-label buttons 64px wide with 11px uppercase/caption labels, separated by thin vertical hairlines #22325a):
   - Group 1: [Open, Save, Undo, Redo]
   - Group 2: [Table, Chart, Pivot, Formula, Add row] (Chart button is hovered with background #22325a or highlighted state)
   - Group 3: [Sort, Filter]
   - Far right: [Format] button.

3. Formula Bar (#ffffff surface, border-b #e0e5ee, h-9 flex items-center px-3 gap-2):
   - Cell reference box "J12" (monospace JetBrains Mono, border #e0e5ee, px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-surface-container-low font-semibold text-xs)
   - "fx" label (italic font-serif/mono text-text-secondary text-sm font-semibold)
   - Formula input displaying "= revenue - cost" in JetBrains Mono (#7b3fe4 for formula color)
   - Cancel (✕) and Accept (✓) micro-buttons.

4. Main Data Grid & Content Area (dense, precision engineered):
   - Row-number gutter (48px wide, #f1f4f9 background, right-aligned line numbers 1 to 24).
   - Column Headers (header row 32px high, raised background #f1f4f9, border-b and border-r #e0e5ee):
     - Columns: order_id (# badge), date (calendar icon badge), region (Aa badge), customer (Aa badge), product (Aa badge), carrier (Aa badge), qty (# badge), revenue ($ badge), cost ($ badge), margin (fx badge, formula column).
     - Under each column name in the header: a tiny SVG distribution histogram (sparkline/histogram bars) showing data spread.
     - Column "revenue" is SELECTED: header tinted (#e5eefe), column cells tinted (#f5f8ff or #e5eefe/40).
     - Cell J12 (Row 12 under Margin or Revenue, specifically at row 12) has a prominent 2px accent selection ring (#2f6fed) with a bottom-right drag handle fill square.
     - Column "margin" shows values styled in the designated formula color (#7b3fe4) in JetBrains Mono.
     - Realistic rows (24 rows visible):
       * order_id: 100001 to 100024
       * date: 2026-07-14, 2026-07-14, 2026-07-13, etc.
       * region: West, East, North, South, Central
       * customer: Acme Corp, Apex Systems, Nexus Tech, Vertex Bio, Meridian Labs, etc.
       * product: Desk Chair, Monitor Arm, Ergonomic Keyboard, 4K Display, Standing Desk, Cable Spine, etc.
       * carrier: UPS, FedEx, DHL
       * qty: 1 to 15 (tabular right-aligned)
       * revenue: $1,284.50, $349.00, $2,490.00, $89.50, etc. (tabular right-aligned)
       * cost: $820.00, $190.00, $1,550.00, $42.00, etc. (tabular right-aligned)
       * margin: $464.50, $159.00, $940.00, $47.50, etc. (in formula color #7b3fe4, tabular right-aligned)
   - Totals row pinned at the bottom of the visible grid with bold totals for qty, revenue ($72,061,236.00), cost, margin.

5. Right Inspector Panel (300px width, docked right, border-l #e0e5ee, bg-white):
   - Tabs across top: "Format · Column · Table" with "Format" active (solid 2px #2f6fed bottom border indicator).
   - Section "NUMBER":
     - Segmented control: [Auto | Number | Currency | Percent] with "Currency" active/selected.
     - Decimals stepper: input with "2" and +/- buttons.
     - "Thousands separator": toggle switch in ON position (#2f6fed fill).
     - Negatives choice: radio/selector showing "-1,234.00" or "(1,234.00)" with -1,234.00 selected.
     - Currency symbol dropdown displaying "$".
   - Section "COLUMN STATS" (for the selected revenue column):
     - Grid of key metrics in JetBrains Mono:
       * count: 1,000,000
       * empty: 0
       * distinct: 812,441
       * min: $4.20
       * max: $9,980.00
       * mean: $72.06
     - An SVG distribution histogram chart showing revenue distribution with a subtle mean marker.

6. Bottom Status Bar (#f3f5f9 or #eef2f8, 26px high, border-t #e0e5ee, flex items-center justify-between px-3):
   - Left: Sheet tabs styled like Excel: "Orders" (active tab on white surface with a 2px #2f6fed top edge), "Report" (inactive tab), and "+" button.
   - Right: JetBrains Mono monospace status metrics: "Sum $72,061,236.00 · Average $72.06 · Count 1,000,000 · GPU RTX 4090 · 0.3 ms".

Aesthetic: Ultra-dense, clean, desktop professional software, exactly 1440x900 viewport, crisp hairlines, zero blur/glassmorphism, flat panels with 6px border radius on cards/buttons, 4px on inputs/chips, 0 on table cells.

outputComponents.text:
I have created the desktop spreadsheet interface for **omxplorer** (1440×900) adhering strictly to your design blueprint and requirements:

### Key Highlights & Architecture:
1. **Title Bar**:
   - Deep navy brand band (`#14213d`) with lowercase brand mark `omxplorer` and a status indicator.
   - Centered document header `orders.csv — 1,000,000 rows`.
   - Action controls on the right: Secondary `Share` and primary `Save` buttons, along with window/user controls.

2. **Branded Toolbar**:
   - Distinct 64px icon-above-label groups partitioned by thin hairline dividers:
     - File & History: `Open`, `Save`, `Undo`, `Redo`
     - Analysis & Transformation: `Table`, `Chart` (*hovered with `#22325a` state*), `Pivot`, `Formula`, `Add row`
     - Operations & View: `Sort`, `Filter`, and docked right `Format`

3. **Formula Bar**:
   - Monospace cell reference badge `J12`, italic `fx` marker, formula input with syntax-highlighted expression `= revenue - cost` in formula violet (`#7b3fe4`), and commit/cancel buttons.

4. **High-Density Data Grid (1 to 24 rows visible)**:
   - 48px row gutter with clean line numbering.
   - Column headers with data-type badges (`#`, `$`, `Aa`, `calendar`, `fx`) and miniature inline distribution histograms.
   - Selected column `revenue` tinted in `#e5eefe`, with active cell `J12` bearing the 2px accent selection ring and drag handle.
   - Dedicated formula column `margin` styled in `#7b3fe4`.
   - Pinned aggregate totals row along the bottom.

5. **Inspector Panel (300px)**:
   - Header with `Format · Column · Table` tabs (active indicator on `Format`).
   - **NUMBER Section**: Segmented control with `Currency` selected, 2-decimal stepper, active `Thousands separator` switch, negative number format selector, and `$` currency dropdown.
   - **COLUMN STATS Section**: Real-time stats (`Count: 1,000,000`, `Empty: 0`, `Distinct: 812,441`, `Min: $4.20`, `Max: $9,980.00`, `Mean: $72.06`) alongside a log-scale distribution bar chart.

6. **Bottom Status Bar**:
   - Excel-style sheet tabs (`Orders` with top accent strip, `Report`, and `+` button).
   - Tabular monospace status metrics: `Sum $72,061,236.00 · Average $72.06 · Count 1,000,000 · GPU RTX 4090 · 0.3 ms`.

outputComponents.suggestion: Switch Inspector to the Column or Table tab to configure schema or joins
Show a chart overlay or split-screen visualizer for the revenue distribution
Add a filter dropdown popover for the region or carrier columns

- Toolbar: icon-above-label buttons 64px wide, in groups separated by thin vertical hairlines; hover fills the raised colour; an active tool has the accent tint.
- Formula bar: cell reference box, "fx" label, monospace input, cancel and accept buttons.
- Data grid: row-number gutter 48px, header row with the column name, a small type badge (#, $, Aa, calendar) and a tiny distribution histogram under the name; body rows 28px with hairlines; selected cell 2px accent ring; selected column tinted; formula columns show their values in the formula colour.
- Inspector: right panel 300px, tabs across the top, small uppercase section titles, flat dropdowns, segmented controls, steppers, switches.
- Sheet tabs: bottom-left, like Excel: flat tabs, active tab on the surface colour with a 2px accent top edge, then a + button.
- Status bar: 26px, monospace figures: rows, selection sum / average / count, the GPU name and the last computation time.
- KPI card: label, big monospace figure, sparkline, delta chip (good or bad colour).
- Charts: flat, thin gridlines, no 3D, the chart series in order.

## Motion
- Short fades only (120 ms). No springs, zooms or blur.
